Chapter 12. Domestic Relations

§ 12.350 Parenting time.

(1) The court shall presume that equal parenting time is in the best interest of the child.

(2) The presumption in sub. (1) may not be rebutted except by clear and convincing evidence that equal parenting time would harm the child.

(3) This section does not apply where the court has found a pattern of domestic abuse under § 12.355.

Current through 2026 Exampleland Act 40; published October 15, 2026.

History: 2021 Act 9; 2026 Act 12; 2026 Act 40.
